---
title: "Sources"
format: html
---

The data for this project comes from the World Bank's World Development Indicators (WDI), accessed through the `WDI` R package.

Indicators used:

- `SP.DYN.LE00.IN`: Life expectancy at birth, total (years)
- `NY.GDP.PCAP.CD`: GDP per capita (current US dollars)
- `SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS`: Current health expenditure (% of GDP)

Coverage:

- country-level observations
- annual data from 2000 to 2023
- region and income-group metadata supplied through WDI

Cleaning approach:

- rename raw WDI codes into readable variables
- remove observations with missing values where needed for each figure
- compare countries by region and income group rather than treating all observations as identical

This setup is suitable for exploratory cross-country development analysis and can be extended later into panel regressions or more focused case studies.
